notes.title: Achievement Bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug regarding the "Synthetic Love" achievement not being granted upon reaching VALA's ending.

If Steam has not granted you the "Synthetic Love" achievement despite viewing VALA's ending, then you can now receive it by viewing that ending again.

I apologize for the inconvenience.
-Lonely Rabbit Games
